artifact: Encoder: P for measured widths 20–22 mm inclusive; H for unmeasured spacers; T for measured widths 23–24 mm. Decoding table: P → pack; H → measure; T → trim. Regenerated messages: S1 → P; S2 → H; S3 → T.
explanation: The original H conflated spacers needing measurement with those needing trimming. Adding T preserves P and the H → measure rule while distinguishing all three required actions. The revised cases are mutually exclusive and cover every permitted spacer: unmeasured, measured 20–22 mm, or measured 23–24 mm. Each message remains one character, using exactly three distinct characters.
